lockFileMaintenance.description: Keep the npm lockfile up to date, merging if tests pass

packageRules.description: Group non-major GitHub Actions updates into a single PR

customManagers.description: Bump the actionlint pinned in _lint.yml. Renovate cannot compute the tarball's sha256, so ACTIONLINT_SHA256 has to be updated by hand in the same PR — until it is, the lint job fails the checksum and goes red.
